## New plugin / update

**Plugin id:** `your-id` (folder `plugins/your-id/`)

**What it does:**

<!-- One or two sentences. A preview.png in the folder helps a lot. -->

### Checklist

- [ ] The folder name matches `id` in `plugin.toml`
- [ ] `plugin.toml`, `main.rhai` and `README.md` are included (and optionally `preview.png`, max 300 KB)
- [ ] Only the permissions the plugin really uses are requested
- [ ] If it flashes the screen, `flashing` is not set to `false`, and the README says so
- [ ] I tested it in BigWave Radio (Plugins → Import .zip, or copy the folder into the plugins folder)
- [ ] I agree my contribution is released under the MIT license

CI checks the plugin automatically and lists the permissions it asks for below.
